description: Fetch one corporate insolvency notice by its id (GET /records/{id}, 1 credit), from insolvency_search or insolvency_notices_search, in any of the sixteen insolvency markets your key may read: the fields of insolvency_search plus notice_text (Spain: the BORME label; Germany: the notice line; null elsewhere) and raw_data (Spain only: the court, procedure number, kind, the resolution and publication dates and the BORME id; never the debtor's identifiers; null elsewhere). Ids from the earlier Spanish-only version of this endpoint no longer apply.

id.description: Notice id, from insolvency_search or insolvency_notices_search.

name: insolvency_record
title: Get insolvency notice
